'''Farend Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in the [[Westwater Settlements]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Tyvar]] and his family took refuge in the cantina.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Farend Cantina appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
